contexts.text: The prince in thy people thou shalt not execrate () = that the doctrine of truth is not to be reviled. Explained.
Beware of falling into the execrable heresy, that God has infused Himself into men...
The abuse of the name of Jehovah God... for the sake of exculpation from evil intentions, which are solemn oaths combined with imprecations. TCR 298.
The nature of his attempts, whether execrations, or magical things, I do not know...
Ye shall be for a curse, for an astonishment, for an execration, and for a reproach () = all things of damnation.
